blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in South Slope. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

South Slope, Burnaby: 38 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 8 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in South Slope fell from 49 in June to 38 in October (−22.4%), and 33 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 2.9% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in South Slope?

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: South Slope condo and townhome stock clusters on the slope south of Rumble Street, along Marine Drive, Nelson Avenue, Patterson Avenue and Sussex Avenue.

Station Hill Drive, above Marine Drive at the east end of the slope, holds a cluster of apartment strata buildings. South Slope Elementary and the B.C. Provincial School for the Deaf, at 4446 Watling Street, sit in the City's Sussex-Nelson planning study area, which names the Nelson Avenue corridor the strata buildings front.
Byrne Creek Ravine Park bounds the strata area on the east. TransLink route 106 runs along the ravine edge via Griffiths Drive and 18th Avenue, on the Edmonds side of the slope.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The strata stock here is low-rise and mid-rise apartment buildings and townhome complexes on the Nelson Avenue, Patterson Avenue, Sussex Avenue and Station Hill Drive corridors, in freehold strata form. Strata property in British Columbia is governed by the Strata Property Act, and most Burnaby apartment and townhome complexes are freehold strata, where each home is a strata lot on a registered strata plan.
Building names and years circulating on listing sites were not used.
Newer ground-oriented strata is the R1 rowhouse form on former house lots.
Rental and pet rules are building-specific here, not area rules.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A secondary suite inside a South Slope townhome cannot be sold separately.
A strata lot within 30 metres of Byrne Creek or a slope ravine can carry a streamside condition.
Strata disputes on the slope go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal (CRT). The Province routes many strata bylaw, fee and governance disputes to the CRT under the strata housing framework.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: South Slope Elementary shares its Watling Street site with the B.C. Provincial School for the Deaf. Heritage Burnaby records that South Slope / B.C.

Nelson Elementary, at 4850 Irmin Street, is the in-area Kindergarten to Grade 7 school for the Nelson Avenue corridor buildings. SD41 lists Nelson Elementary at that Irmin Street address on its provincial school list.

The Michael J. Fox Theatre sits on the Burnaby South Secondary campus at 5455 Rumble Street. The secondary school serving the slope's strata homes is also the local community theatre site, north of the Station Hill Drive buildings.
A strata home's sewer parcel tax is shared across its parcel.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), adopted December 9, 2025, sets the city-wide land use direction that now governs rezoning proposals on the Marine Drive and Nelson Avenue corridors.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in Burnaby, a listed Metro Vancouver taxable area, so a strata home left empty still needs its annual declaration.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Patterson Station and Royal Oak Station, both on the Expo Line, serve the top of the slope. Metrotown, a City-designated town centre, is the retail and transit hub immediately northwest of the Nelson Avenue buildings.

Marine Drive and Marine Way run along the bottom of the slope toward New Westminster and the Big Bend area. Nelson Avenue, Patterson Avenue and Sussex Avenue are the north–south streets linking the strata corridors to Rumble Street and Kingsway.
Route 106 links the east edge of the slope to Edmonds and New Westminster stations.

blocks.text: South Slope Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Byrne Creek SPEA before buying a ravine-edge strata home.

Check the strata's registered bylaws and Form B, not the listing, for rental and pet rules. The Province's strata framework puts those rules in each corporation's bylaws, and the Civil Resolution Tribunal resolves many disputes over them.

blocks.text: South Slope home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

47 condos sold in South Slope with a median price of $621,000 (the middle half sold between $551,750 and $698,750), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $672 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $471 a month. 9 townhomes sold in South Slope with a median price of $840,000 (the middle half sold between $740,000 and $900,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $690 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median strata fee of $510 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in South Slope?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 38 condos and townhomes listed in South Slope. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is South Slope a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in South Slope had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in South Slope from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 33 condos and townhomes sold in South Slope over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Which schools serve a South Slope townhome on Nelson Avenue?
faq.a: Check the exact address in the School District 41 (SD41) locator first. Nelson Elementary, Kindergarten to Grade 7, is at 4850 Irmin Street, South Slope Elementary is at 4446 Watling Street, and Burnaby South Secondary, Grade 8 to Grade 12, is at 5455 Rumble Street. The district groups Nelson and South Slope elementaries with Burnaby South Secondary in its Kingsway South zone.

faq.q: How do I reach SkyTrain from a Station Hill Drive condo?
faq.a: There is no station on Station Hill Drive itself. The slope's stations are Patterson Station and Royal Oak Station on the Expo Line, north of Rumble Street, and TransLink buses on Nelson Avenue and Patterson Avenue connect the strata corridors to those stations and to Metrotown, one station west of Patterson.

faq.q: What utility bill does a strata home here pay?
faq.a: A multiple-family dwelling pays its own Burnaby utility rates. The City's 2026 residential table charges a multiple-family dwelling $374.54 for water and $436.00 for sewer use, with a 5% discount if the notice is paid by the due date, separate from the strata fees the building collects.

faq.q: Can the strata restrict rentals or pets in my building?
faq.a: Yes, if its registered bylaws say so. Ask for the current bylaws and Form B for the specific building on Station Hill Drive, Nelson Avenue or Patterson Avenue before writing an offer.

faq.q: What did condos in South Slope sell for?
faq.a: 47 condos sold in South Slope between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $621,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in South Slope?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
